name: restaurant-bill-splitter
title: Restaurant Bill Splitter
summary: Split a restaurant receipt by shares with reconciled per-person amounts.
description: Split an itemized restaurant receipt among up to eight named diners, allocate tax and tip in proportion to their items, and create a new workbook and per-person summary. Includes an independent standard-library arithmetic helper and a workbook layout reference; the original template, recording and Creator are not runtime dependencies. Requires existing native receipt-reading, Python and spreadsheet facilities. This adapted contributed source has no attested native installation or invocation.
